plugin.name: IP-KVM
plugin.description: See and control machines through PiKVM, NanoKVM and JetKVM devices.

view.title: See KVMs
view.description: Open the KVM tab and see which KVMs are online and what power state they report.

power.title: Control power
power.description: Turn machines on and off and reset them through their KVM, or wake them with Wake-on-LAN.

console.title: Use the screen
console.description: See the screen of a machine and use its keyboard and mouse.

media.title: Use virtual media
media.description: Mount and eject ISO images on a machine.

maxSessionMinutes.label: Longest screen session (minutes)
maxSessionMinutes.description: A screen session ends after this long. Use 0 for no limit.

description: Add your IP-KVMs to see and control the machines behind them. Termix connects to the KVM, so the screen works even when your browser cannot reach it. Logins are stored encrypted and never shown again.

confirm.off: Cut the power of {{name}}? The system does not shut down cleanly.
confirm.reset: Reset {{name}}? The system restarts at once.

form.name: Name
form.hostHint: Link the KVM to the host it belongs to. It then follows that host's sharing and shows on its host menu.
form.caHint: Most KVMs use a self signed certificate. Paste its PEM here so Termix can trust it. Leave empty for a trusted certificate.
form.caSet: A certificate is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
form.keepLogin: Leave empty to keep the saved login
form.testNeedsLogin: Enter the login again to test.
form.macHint: The network card of the machine, for Wake-on-LAN.
form.broadcastHint: Where the wake packet goes. Leave empty for 255.255.255.255.

view.jetHint: The JetKVM video goes straight from the JetKVM to your browser, so your browser must reach it on the network.

screen.pasteLabel: Text to type on the machine

media.empty: There are no images on this KVM.
media.name: Save it as

widget.name: KVM devices
widget.description: Which of your IP-KVMs are up.
